mentions.h: Second on the Common but 'Thames' increase their lead

photos.c: Above: Belgrave's South of Thames Championship winning team 1999 - Rob Harding, Charlie Dickinson, Kevin Quinn, Phil Carstairs (obscured), Paul Coughlan, Roger Alsop, Mike Kazimierski, Jerome Curtat (behind), Don Anderson, Najibe Hliouat, Saul Armanini and Graham Adams.
